proof: Every added edge must have both endpoints deficient. A closed5walk from root using>=2 added edges has length>=2+2+2=6. With exactly1 added edge, both endpoints must be distinct deficient vertices at distance2 from root; only184 exists. No oldNB5 closed walk exists. Hence no simple maxdegree4 supergraph on the same192 vertices can be exactNB5.
